items.title: Show HN: RPI Pico (RP2040) PIO Emulator Package for Go
items.contentSnippet:
I have been developing a bus communication protocol for a while using the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040)'s programmable IO (PIO) hardware (basically- 8 tiny processors that run assembly programs to manipulate GPIO pins) and I needed some way of testing my programs, as the real hardware is undebuggable.
Unfortunately, none of the existing emulators I could find supported connecting multiple RP2040s together, and they each had a few different missing bits of functionality, so I decided to make my own!

items.title: Show HN: Castellan – A real-time strategy game for agents
items.contentSnippet:
In an RTS game, making decisions quickly matters as much as making good ones. Looking for the balance between cost, speed and intelligence in agents, I started wondering what an agent playing an RTS would look like. So I built a simple RTS, and I keep making it more complex.
- The game keeps running while the agent thinks
- The agent can upload a JavaScript script for each unit type
- 300+ game replays
- Connects through MCP or CLI. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Antigravity CLI, Ope

items.title: Show HN: RCE in Atlantis
items.contentSnippet:
Back in August we found this cool bypass of developer restrictions in Atlantis, leading to an unreviewed terraform apply & RCE! The vulnerable Gitea approval path dates back to the integration's introduction in v0.28.0 (May 2024), so the bypass was most likely present for roughly two and a half years before the patch shipped in October 2026. Enjoy!

items.title: The focus on AI safety disasters ignores everyday harms
items.contentSnippet: Consider what passes for success in technology policy. An AI company promises that its chatbot will not encourage suicide.
